anchors.decision: preserve vertical towers and upward reading direction

anchors.decision: use operator-specific fills and varying widths instead of uniform cards

anchors.observation: residual paths loop around each sublayer; stacked gray outlines and N× denote repeated layers

anchors.observation: positional encoding is a waveform entering a circled plus at each embedding stream

anchors.observation: Q and K converge at first MatMul; V bypasses scale/mask/softmax and enters last MatMul
